Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]

A stand-in for `claude --help`, written for these tests in the layout it prints: the options the
workspace reads, with words of its own.

Arguments:
  prompt                                What to ask

Options:
  --debug-file <path>                   Write a debug log to this file
  --effort <level>                      Effort level for the current session
                                        (low, medium, high, xhigh, max)
  --environment <environment_id>        Create a new cloud session that runs on
                                        the environment named
  --model <model>                       Model for the current session: an alias
                                        or a full name
  --output-format <format>              How a printed answer is written
                                        (choices: "text", "json",
                                        "stream-json")
  --permission-mode <mode>              Permission mode to use for the session
                                        (choices: "acceptEdits", "auto",
                                        "bypassPermissions", "manual",
                                        "dontAsk", "plan")
  -p, --print                           Print an answer and exit
  -v, --version                         Output the version number
  -h, --help                            Display help for command
